messages:
Maya Chen: quick check — who owns the remaining postmortem items for INC-984? want owners + firm due dates so we can close this out by end of sprint.

Igor Petrov: I'm taking DB schema migration and the migration rollback play. ETA: 2026-03-05 EOD. Need approvals from eng-infra for downtime window.

Samir Patel: I'll update the runbook and add the postmortem summary to /docs/incidents/INC-984. PR opened: https://github.com/redwoodinc/runbooks/pull/452 — reviewers: @Nina @Alex

Nina Gomez: I own the alert tuning and SLO checklist. Targeting 2026-03-04 AM. Blocker: need current SLO dashboards from observability team (haven't gotten the export).

Rahul Singh: I'll coordinate the integration test harness and canary plan. Will need a dedicated test slot on dedicated infra on 3/6. Pinged @Alex for capacity.

Alex (eng-infra): we can reserve a 2hr slot on 2026-03-06 10:00-12:00 for canary. Need the exact workload script and data size. @Rahul attach the script here.

Rahul Singh: attaching the script snippet:
```bash
# canary workload
python tools/canary.py --qps 50 --duration 600 --seed 42
```
I'll push full artifact to the test-bucket by EOD today.

incident-bot: checklist update for INC-984: migration=assigned->Igor, runbook=assigned->Samir, alerts=assigned->Nina, canary=assigned->Rahul

Maya Chen: great — please add firm due dates to the tracking doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/incidents/INC-984-tracker and reply here when done. If any cross-team perms are needed, call it out.

Samir Patel: done — added PR link and ETA 2026-03-04 17:00. @Maya please review the summary section.

Nina Gomez: requested the dashboard export from observability (ticket #OBS-778). ETA for export: 2026-03-03. If delayed I'll temporarily use synthetic SLI values.

Igor Petrov: noted. Also flag: security review needed for migration script. @security-team can you do expedited review? low risk but needs signoff.

Security Team (security-bot): received request OBS-984-MIG. SLA: 3 business days. If urgency, DM @Lara.

Maya Chen: ok — if security SLA pushes us past the sprint, we do canary without migration and keep migration gated. Everyone ack this plan?

Rahul Singh: ack

Samir Patel: ack

Nina Gomez: ack

Igor Petrov: ack — I'll prepare rollback steps in case canary shows regressions.

Maya Chen: thanks all. I'll close the loop in the incident tracker after PR merges. :thumbsup:
